, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. VIBHU BAKHRU, CHIEF JUSTICE  and  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE C.M. POONACHA  -9-  NC: 2026:KHC:3409-DB  CCC No. 1206 of 2025  HC-KAR  ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MR. VIBHU BAKHRU, CHIEF JUSTICE)
1.
The complainants have filed the present complaint alleging willful disobedience of the order dated 19.08.2025 passed by a Coordinate Bench of this Court in Writ Petition No.24182/2025 (S- KSAT).

In terms of the said order, this Court, inter alia, directed as under:
We request the Tribunal to dispose of the application as early as possible, as the learned counsels appearing for the parties have assured that they would co-operate in disposal of the application.

In view of disposal of the petition, pending interlocutory application would not survive and it stands disposed of accordingly.
2.
The complainants allege that the said order was not complied with as the necessary directions for continuance of the complainants as Food Safety Officers was not immediately passed.

sentences.text: Apparently, a memo has been filed enclosing therewith an order dated 03.11.2025, whereby the Commissioner, Food and Drugs Administration, Bengaluru, has passed an order directing the - 10 - NC: 2026:KHC:3409-DB HC-KAR petitioners/complainants to continue as Food Safety Officers in the Commissionerate of Food Safety, till the disposal of the application pending before the Hon'ble Karnataka Appellate Tribunal.

The said order has been passed in compliance with the directions passed by this Court in the order dated 19.08.2025.
4.
It is the complainants case that there is an inordinate delay in passing the order, which has effectively deprived them of the salary.
The respondents/accused were directed to continue the complainants/petitioners as Food Safety Officers by the order dated 19.08.2025.

Clearly, the said directions would take effect from that date notwithstanding the delay in passing any order in furtherance of the directions in the order dated 19.08.2025.
5.
The complaint is closed with the aforesaid clarification.

Sd/-

The complainants have filed the present complaint alleging willful disobedience of the order dated 19.08.2025 passed by a Coordinate Bench of this Court in Writ Petition No.24182/2025 (S- KSAT).
It is the complainants case that there is an inordinate delay in passing the order, which has effectively deprived them of the salary.
opennyai_summary.decision:
In view of disposal of the petition, pending interlocutory application would not survive and it stands disposed of accordingly.
2.
The said order has been passed in compliance with the directions passed by this Court in the order dated 19.08.2025.
4.
The respondents/accused were directed to continue the complainants/petitioners as Food Safety Officers by the order dated 19.08.2025.
Clearly, the said directions would take effect from that date notwithstanding the delay in passing any order in furtherance of the directions in the order dated 19.08.2025.
5.
The complaint is closed with the aforesaid clarification.
